Maya: Velox Labs - reserved GPU pool pulse (24h snapshot)
Maya: 24h GPU hours: 1,820h (-8% w/w). Avg saturation 78% (peak 96% @ 02:14 UTC). Mean queue depth 3.6, p95 queue 9.
Maya: Observed a short tail-latency spike for infer routes (p95 260ms -> 480ms during 02:10-02:20). CS ticket #CS-4123 opened for customer-facing delay.
Maya: Suggest temporary burst +1 A100 for 6h tonight to clear queue; also want to try batch_size=16 on canary.
Scheduler Bot: autoscaler: scale_down prevented by pinned jobs 3x in last 24h; burst capacity available in eu-west1: 1x A100.
Owen: saw KV cache miss rate jump to 14% during the spike, likely causing repeated decoding hits. I'll run a small test to rewarm prefixes.
Owen: running quick test now:
```sh
redwood-cli pool exec velox-reserved -- cmd='python tools/rewarm_prefix_cache.py --range=24h'
```
Luca: infra: we can provision the burst A100 in ~18min if approved. No conflicts with other reserved pools.
Tara: flagging risk: if queues remain >5 for >12h we'll need to open a renewal conversation; Velox' SLA tier may trigger credits.
Maya: ok let's do this order: 1) Owen tries rewarm & batch tweak (canary) 2) if p95 queue >7 after 30m, provision +1 A100 burst for 6h 3) CS to prep comms if we hit SLA window.
Owen: acknowledged. I'll post results in 30m. @Luca please hold burst until I confirm.
Luca: will hold. ping me when ready.
Maya: thanks — attaching dashboard snapshot: https://dash.redwood/velox/metrics?range=24h :thumbsup:
Tara: FYI customer onboards extra model next week, could push baseline up by ~25%.
Owen: test done — batch_size -> 16 reduced p95 latency to 220ms and queue p95 to 6. Results in channel in 10.
Maya: great, hold on burst for now. I'll update CS ticket and follow up tomorrow.
